label: CLAUDE.md#Default to background-subagent dispatch chunk 4
title: CLAUDE.md#Default to background-subagent dispatch chunk 4
summary: Pairing a judge task is the dispatcher's duty, too. When dispatching a **substantive impl task, the dispatcher ALSO creates a judge task** wired blocking (blocked_by) that impl task, before dispatching the impl — so the judge goes ready automatically the moment the impl completes and the loop spawns it. This reuses the existing DAG-gate trigger (a task blocked_by its deps goes ready when they finish); no new trigger machinery. The judge task must be **skill-tagged in its handoff/prompt** — the daemon does not know skills, so the skill selection rides the prompt exactly like impl workers: the judge worker invokes **self-learn-judge in single-attempt review mode** against the impl's attempt branch (orch/attempt/<impl-key>). In that mode the review IS the verdict — it fetches the attempt diff (get_attempt_diff), applies the code-review rubric (correctness, scope discipline, dead/redundant code, test presence/quality, style) and either APPROVES (hold-merge by default — records the verdict without merging; in automode (config.automode=true) include {action:"merge", task_key:"<impl_key>", reason:"APPROVE"} in the complete_task verdicts array so the daemon auto-merges the attempt) or KICK
